label: 17–23 October
notes: Cook in this order: fish goes first while it's freshest.
Chicken thighs keep till night 6 in the fridge. Check the use-by date, and freeze on arrival if it falls earlier.
Protein figures are estimates per person.

dinners.title: Honey-tamari salmon with rice & broccoli
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer it in plenty of water for 11–12 min, then drain.
Mix the tamari, honey, garlic and ginger. Brush half of it over the salmon.
Air fry the salmon skin-side down at 200°C for 9–10 min. Brush with more glaze at the halfway point.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 4 min.
Serve, spoon over the leftover glaze and scatter with spring onion.
dinners.tip: The salmon is done when it flakes easily but is still slightly glossy in the centre.

dinners.title: Lemon cod with crushed new potatoes & peas
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15–18 min, until tender. Add the peas for the last 3 min, then drain.
Rub the cod with ½ tbsp oil, the lemon zest, garlic, paprika and salt.
Air fry the cod at 200°C for 8–10 min, until it flakes.
Roughly crush the potatoes and peas with the rest of the oil, half the lemon juice and the spring onion. Season.
Serve the cod on top, with the rest of the lemon squeezed over.
dinners.tip: Line the air fryer basket with baking paper so the cod lifts out in one piece.

dinners.title: Garlic prawn & chickpea tomato skillet
steps: Fry the garlic gently in the oil for 1 min, without letting it brown.
Add the paprika and chilli, then the tomatoes and chickpeas. Simmer for 8 min.
Stir in the prawns and cook for 3–4 min, until pink all the way through.
Wilt in the spinach, squeeze over the lemon and season.
Serve in bowls.
dinners.tip: Frozen prawns? Move them to the fridge the night before, or put them in a sealed bag in cold water for 20 min.

dinners.title: Smoky turkey chilli with rice
steps: Put the rice on to cook.
Heat the oil and brown the turkey on a high heat for 5 min, breaking it up.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 4 min. Stir in the garlic and spices for 30 sec.
Add the tomatoes and beans with a splash of water. Simmer for 12–15 min until thick, then season.
Serve over the rice with a spoonful of yoghurt.
dinners.tip: Makes plenty. Any leftovers make a good lunch.

dinners.title: Beef & pepper stir-fry with ginger
steps: Put the rice on to cook (11–12 min).
Heat a wok until smoking. Add half the oil and sear the beef in 2 batches for 1–2 min each. Set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, then the onion and peppers. Stir-fry for 4 min.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 min.
Return the beef, add the tamari, honey and spring onions, and toss for 1 min. Serve on the rice.
dinners.tip: Pat the beef dry first and don't crowd the pan. That's what gets it browned instead of stewed.

dinners.title: Paprika chicken thighs, sweet potato wedges & green beans
steps: Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges. Toss with ½ tbsp oil and a pinch of salt. Air fry at 200°C for 10 min.
Meanwhile, toss the chicken with the rest of the oil, the paprika, cumin, garlic, salt and pepper.
Shake the wedges, add the chicken alongside them and air fry for 14–16 min more, turning the chicken halfway. It's done when the juices run clear.
While it cooks, boil the green beans for 4 min, then drain.
Squeeze the lemon over the chicken and serve.
dinners.tip: Small air fryer? Cook the wedges first, keep them warm in the oven, then cook the chicken.

dinners.title: Feta shakshuka with crispy new potatoes
steps: Toss the potatoes with ½ tbsp oil and salt. Air fry at 200°C for 20 min, shaking halfway.
Meanwhile, soften the onion and pepper in the rest of the oil for 6 min. Add the garlic and spices for 30 sec.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 6 min until thick. Stir in the spinach.
Make 6 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on a low heat for 5–7 min, until the whites are set.
Crumble over the feta and serve with the potatoes.
dinners.tip: A lid is what sets the tops of the eggs. A baking tray works if you don't have one.
